A strict widower lives with his four daughters, but forbids them to socialize or work. When the father retires, he decides to invest his pension in a company that he later discovers has seized his money. He gets injured and the girls are forced to go to work.

Lillian is a Jewish dancer who has a number of admirers, including Farid, a wealthy lonely young man. Lillian leaves Farid to go to Palestine. Farid then meets Gawaher, another dancer who is married to El Sebai, who, along with his colleague Sombol, protects her. Gawaher refuses to give any of what she earns to El Sebai, so he attempts to rob and kill Farid.
Ramzy is a playboy whose boss tries to wed to his daughter, Laila. When Ramzy and Laila meet, a man they don't know leaves them a bag full of money which sends the real owner of the bag after them.

A reckless young man's life is turned upside down after he quarrels with his mother, as a curse befalls him that makes him constantly fail, especially after his involvement with Walid and Sanaa in a fraud.

Karim is a professional painter who has a relationship with Sahar, a girl who came to Paris and is anxious and hesitant as the Lebanese war is always in her mind. Karim realizes that he has to treat her with caution, as she may be mature or act like a child, and a strange love story develops between the two of them.

After having trouble with the dancer who worked with him for several months, the drummer Abdo discovers a young dancer Mabahig who lives with her sister and her brother-in-law. He trains her till she becomes a famous dancer.

Hassan (Ahmed Helmy) is a devoted aeronautical engineer who is so busy with his job. He falls in love with Farida and turns to his father (Mahmoud Hamida) for advice, while his mother opposes his way of life. As events unfold, there is an unexpected surprise.

Third Face tells the story of a doctor who gets released from prison and goes on a quest to find her daughter while struggling with psychosis. On the other hand, Metaverse tells the story of a woman who enters the virtual world to take revenge against her enemies.

p.d: Financial director Kate Reedy struggles to find the balance between her demanding career and her family. As she gets an account that sends her on many trips to New York, she spreads herself too thin as she works even harder to hold on to her motherhood and her career orientation.

When he wakes up from his coma, he finds himself faced with strange things and concepts that he has never witnessed before. He must keep up with the times and the developments that have occurred but finds it difficult to do so.
